fields.Name: T153 - Studio Overview Entry Paths
fields.Description: Exercises the ps-home Overview panel (KPI computation + navigate emit wiring) — a distinct action-forward landing panel, not the section shell itself.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Studio' door and make sure the 'Overview' section is active (it is the default). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Verify the Overview landing renders: a hero band titled 'Build a predictive model', a KPI strip (Published / Active Experiments / Best Holdout AUC / Scored this week), three entry-path cards ('Start from data', 'Use a template', 'Ask the agent'), and a 'Recent Activity' timeline (which may be an empty state). Then click the 'Start from data' or 'Use a template' entry-path card and verify the workbench navigates to a different section (e.g. Training Pipelines or Algorithm Catalog).

judgeValidationCriteria: The Overview hero, KPI strip, and three entry-path cards render
Clicking an entry-path card navigates the Studio to the corresponding section (Pipelines or Catalog)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
